'''King Scorpions''' are the larger and more [[aggressive]] cousins of [[scorpion]]s and favour rocky areas. They patrol the [[iron rock|iron]] and [[luminite rock]]s in the [[dwarven mines]] north of the [[Mining Guild]] door and the [[runite rock]]s along the north shore of [[Crandor]].

King scorpions are aggressive and attack with melee, making these areas dangerous for low-level players. Their large size means they can be easily trapped behind rocks, however.

==Trivia==
* King scorpions were larger than ordinary scorpions in [[Runescape Classic]] and most of pre-HD [[Runescape 2]]; however, their [[Update:Small spiders, kalphites, scorpions and metal dragons|initial graphical update]] changed them to be the same size as regular scorpions, though with a different colour scheme. The examine text remains unchanged and still mentions their size.
